text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The mastermind of "Hizbollah-Gulf" cell flees Kuwait. The Gulf state has arrested a group of 11 Bahrainis and other Gulf Arabs accused of trying to harm Kuwait's security.
- Swiss-Swedish ABB and Fisa Italiampianti of Italy to award sub-contracts worth 25 million dinars to Bahrain firms for construction work of a 171 million dinar power and water plant.

- Emir directs Oil Ministry to participate in joint ventures with the U.S. firm Caltex. Bahrain bought Caltex's 40 percent stake in Bahrain Petroleum Company, which runs the oil refinery, from April 1.
- First Islamic Investment Bank says to raise its paid-in capital to $50 million from $15 million.
